// Watchlist: [Yahoo Finance symbol, display name, kind]
// Edit freely. Symbols Yahoo can't resolve are skipped without breaking the run.
const WATCHLIST = [
  // Sources disagree on Yahoo's PSEi symbol, so try both. Parse Market Data keeps the first that returns data.
  ['PSEI.PS', 'PSEi', 'index'],
  ['^PSEI',   'PSEi', 'index'],

  ['ALI.PS',  'Ayala Land', 'stock'],
  ['AC.PS',   'Ayala Corp', 'stock'],
  ['BDO.PS',  'BDO Unibank', 'stock'],
  ['BPI.PS',  'BPI', 'stock'],
  ['MBT.PS',  'Metrobank', 'stock'],
  ['SM.PS',   'SM Investments', 'stock'],
  ['SMPH.PS', 'SM Prime', 'stock'],
  ['TEL.PS',  'PLDT', 'stock'],
  ['GLO.PS',  'Globe Telecom', 'stock'],
  ['ICT.PS',  'ICTSI', 'stock'],
  ['JFC.PS',  'Jollibee', 'stock'],
  ['MER.PS',  'Meralco', 'stock'],
  ['URC.PS',  'Universal Robina', 'stock'],

  ['PHP=X',   'USD/PHP', 'macro'],
  ['BZ=F',    'Brent crude', 'macro'],
  ['^TNX',    'US 10Y yield', 'macro'],
  ['^GSPC',   'S&P 500', 'macro'],
  ['^HSI',    'Hang Seng', 'macro'],
];

return WATCHLIST.map(([symbol, name, kind]) => ({ json: { symbol, name, kind } }));

// One item per news row, matching the news_items columns.
return ($input.first().json.news_rows || []).map(r => ({ json: r }));
